properties: Sprint Status (Select: Planning, Active, Completed, Paused)
relations: DB_Daily_Logs is related to DB_Wealth_Ledger (via weekly reconciliation records)
rollups: Average Sleep Score from DB_Daily_Logs to DB_Quarterly_Sprints
Habit Completion Rate from DB_Daily_Logs to DB_Quarterly_Sprints
Total Asset Value from DB_Wealth_Ledger to DB_Life_Areas (Wealth Pillar)
formulas: Net Worth Formula: prop('Asset Value') - prop('Liability Value')
Visual Progress Bar: slice('▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓', 0, round(prop('Progress') * 10)) + slice('░░░░░░░░░░', 0, 10 - round(prop('Progress') * 10)) + ' ' + format(round(prop('Progress') * 100)) + '%'
views: Today's Alignment (Board view grouped by Chronotype peak energy blocks)
